description:
Feather (soften) the edges of the active pixel selection.

Use when: soft transitions before fill, mask, or delete operations.
Do NOT use when: a hard edge is required or no selection exists.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { pixels, bounds?, context } }.
Preconditions: active document and active pixel selection. Side effects: modifies selection edges.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null or 0 to use the active document. A positive number activates that document before the tool runs. When no document is open, a stale id does not block the call.

name: photoshop_feather_selection
